notes:
Account overview: Liminal HealthWorks — mid-to-large healthtech provider focused on clinical documentation automation and patient engagement. Existing pilot on Redwood hosted API (chat + document search). Wants to convert to a multi-region Dedicated deployment with Optimize adopted for lower token unit cost and automated batching. Key requirements: HIPAA+SOC2, SSO for 6k internal users, audit logs retention 7 years, KMS integration with Azure Key Vault, EU data residency for certain cohorts, on-prem option for air-gapped research environment.

POC summary: POC showed strong quality on clinical summarization (ROUGE/F1 comparable to reference), but cost/headroom concerns for predicted QPS at scale. Redwood SE (Jordan) suggested Dedicated pool + quantized model variant; internal infra team liked fallback routing for peak periods.

Quotes & appetite: CEO said "we need predictable economics for 2026 budgeting"; Head of AI Ops asked for SLA and canary rollout plan. Procurement pushed expected PO date to March.

Security + legal: provided SOC2+HIPAA checklist; legal asked for data processing addendum (DPA) with specific residencies. Security asked for third-party pen test report and KMS flow diagrams. We provided security-faq doc and a sandbox SOW template.

Commercial: initial recommended footprint: 4 dedicated instances (A100/80GB equiv), 2 warm standby regions (NA, EU) + APAC read-replica; Optimize adoption to reduce token costs by 20-35% depending on batching profiles. Estimated ARR range shared (200k-500k).

Operational notes: prefer VPC peering over public endpoints; retention and egress controls required. Engineering wants a 2-week on-prem proof-of-concept for the research lab.

Open items: exact Dedicated sizing, final pricing for APAC add-on, updated SOW with on-prem clause, procurement PO cadence.

Artifacts: pricing deck, security-faq, and SOW draft in Drive (links below). Recent meetings recorded — Fireflies attached. Gmail thread exposing procurement questions attached. Jira ticket for POC bug -> INF-3241.
